---
title: "Crypto Markets"
format: html
execute:
  echo: false
---


```{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
library(arrow)
```

```{r}
open_dataset("data/daily_prices.parquet")$schema
```

```{r}
prices <- read_parquet("data/daily_prices.parquet")
metadata <- read_parquet("data/coin_metadata.parquet")
categories <- read_parquet("data/categories.parquet")

crypto <- prices |>
  mutate(date = as.Date(date_raw)) |>
  left_join(metadata, by = "coin_id") |>
  left_join(
    categories |> rename(category_description = description),
    by = "category_id"
  )
```

```{r}
category_order <- crypto |>
  group_by(date, category_name) |>
  summarise(daily_market_cap_usd = sum(market_cap_usd, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") |>
  group_by(category_name) |>
  summarise(typical_market_cap_usd = median(daily_market_cap_usd), .groups = "drop") |>
  arrange(desc(typical_market_cap_usd)) |>
  pull(category_name)

market_share <- crypto |>
  group_by(date, category_name) |>
  summarise(market_cap_usd = sum(market_cap_usd, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") |>
  mutate(category_name = factor(category_name, levels = category_order))

events <- tibble(
  start = as.Date(c("2022-05-07", "2022-11-08")),
  end = as.Date(c("2022-05-12", "2022-11-11")),
  label = c("Luna / UST crash", "FTX collapse"),
  label_date = as.Date(c("2022-05-09", "2022-11-09")),
  label_y = c(0.98, 0.88)
)

ggplot(market_share, aes(x = date, y = market_cap_usd, fill = category_name)) +
  geom_area(position = "fill") +
  geom_rect(
    data = events,
    aes(xmin = start, xmax = end, ymin = 0, ymax = 1),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    fill = "grey20",
    alpha = 0.25
  ) +
  geom_vline(
    data = events,
    aes(xintercept = start),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    color = "grey20",
    linetype = "dashed"
  ) +
  geom_vline(
    data = events,
    aes(xintercept = end),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    color = "grey20",
    linetype = "dashed"
  ) +
  geom_label(
    data = events,
    aes(x = label_date, y = label_y, label = label),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    size = 3,
    vjust = 1
  ) +
  scale_fill_viridis_d(option = "D", end = 0.85, name = "Category") +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::label_percent()) +
  labs(
    title = "Crypto market capitalization by category",
    subtitle = "Daily share of recorded market cap; category shares sum to 100% each day",
    x = NULL,
    y = "Share of total crypto market cap",
    caption = "Source: daily_prices.parquet, joined with coin_metadata.parquet and categories.parquet."
  )
```

```{r}
open_dataset("data/daily_prices.parquet") |>
  to_duckdb() |>
  filter(date_raw >= "2025-01-01") |>
  group_by(coin_id) |>
  summarise(
    avg_market_cap_usd = mean(market_cap_usd, na.rm = TRUE),
    days = n_distinct(date_raw)
  ) |>
  arrange(desc(avg_market_cap_usd)) |>
  collect()
```

```{r}
metadata |>
  mutate(launch_date_parsed = coalesce(
    as.Date(launch_date, format = "%Y-%m-%d"),
    as.Date(launch_date, format = "%B %d, %Y")
  )) |>
  arrange(launch_date_parsed) |>
  select(coin_id, coin_name, launch_date, launch_date_parsed)
```
